description: This source file defines classes and functions for interpreting and transforming FX graphs in PyTorch, including the Interpreter and Transformer classes, which execute and modify FX graph modules.

classes.name: Interpreter
classes.description: Executes an FX graph node-by-node, allowing for custom behavior and partial evaluation.

classes.name: Transformer
classes.description: A specialized interpreter that produces a new transformed module by symbolically modifying the FX graph.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the module via interpretation, returning the result.

methods.name: boxed_run
methods.description: Runs the module with a list of arguments, ensuring prompt deallocation of input tensors.

methods.name: run_node
methods.description: Executes a specific FX graph node.

methods.name: placeholder
methods.description: Handles 'placeholder' nodes, consuming arguments from an iterator.

methods.name: get_attr
methods.description: Retrieves an attribute from the module hierarchy.

methods.name: output
methods.description: Handles 'output' nodes, returning the final result.

methods.name: fetch_attr
methods.description: Fetches an attribute from the module hierarchy.

methods.name: fetch_args_kwargs_from_env
methods.description: Retrieves concrete args and kwargs for a node from the environment.

methods.name: map_nodes_to_values
methods.description: Recursively maps node args to their concrete values in the environment.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Transforms the module by modifying its FX graph and returns a new GraphModule.
